title: a job that names no asset is not a mismatch
why: proc_pickup_v1 names no asset and never will — the subject is whatever was on the desk. Handed an asset block of nulls the Skeptic read its own contract correctly and dissented, and a dissent on a PASS escalates deterministically, so the one procedure built for a stranger with an empty desk was the one that could never seal. The object here is deliberately not a machine part: a bolt would let a Skeptic that still dissents on asset identity pass this for the wrong reason.
